plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Ceragon FibeAir microwave transmission device. It reports uptime, RFU and PA temperature, IDU temperature and input voltage, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 2281).
name: Transmission

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Highest RFU temperature of the Ceragon FibeAir device in degrees Celsius, read per RFU from MWRM-RADIO-MIB genEquipRfuStatusTemperature (1.3.6.1.4.1.2281.10.5.1.1.4). High values may indicate cooling problems or high ambient temperature at the outdoor unit.

metrics.name: device_temperature_pa_celsius
metrics.description: Highest power amplifier (PA) temperature of the Ceragon FibeAir RFUs in degrees Celsius, read from MWRM-RADIO-MIB genEquipRfuStatusPATemp (1.3.6.1.4.1.2281.10.5.1.1.24). Models without this object leave it empty.

metrics.name: device_idu_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Indoor unit (IDU) temperature of the Ceragon FibeAir device in degrees Celsius, from MWRM-UNIT-MIB genEquipUnitIduTemperature (1.3.6.1.4.1.2281.10.1.1.9.0). When genEquipUnitMeasurementSystem (1.3.6.1.4.1.2281.10.1.1.8.0) is imperial the Fahrenheit reading is converted to Celsius; readings outside -50 to 150 are dropped.

metrics.name: device_voltage_input
metrics.description: Input supply voltage of the Ceragon FibeAir indoor unit as reported by MWRM-UNIT-MIB genEquipUnitIduVoltageInput (1.3.6.1.4.1.2281.10.1.1.10.0), reported as the raw integer in volts.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
